edition.tagline: Bouquets of sharpened pencils. Plates of cheese.
edition.cue: Serve the snacks when Joe sits down at Kathleen's cafe table.

s.note: Chilled baked cheesecake squares on biscuit bases, each topped with a cherry.
s.how: Make one shared cheesecake slab for the bites and dessert. Line a 20cm square slice tin. Crush 180g digestive biscuits, mix with 75g melted butter and press into the base. Beat 600g cream cheese with 140g caster sugar until smooth. Beat in 150g sour cream, 3 eggs and 1 tsp vanilla extract. Pour over the base and bake at 150°C conventional for 50 to 60 minutes until the edges are set and the centre gently wobbles. Cool in the switched-off oven for 1 hour, then chill overnight. Cut a quarter of the slab into 8 small squares and top each with one of 8 pitted cherries. Reserve the remaining three quarters for Cafe cheesecake.
shop: 1 tsp vanilla extract, shared with dessert@Pantry

s.note: Toasted mini bagels with spring onion cream cheese and cracked pepper.
s.how: Halve and toast 4 mini bagels until golden, about 3 minutes under a medium grill. Whip 120g cream cheese with 2 finely sliced spring onions and 1/4 tsp cracked black pepper. Spread over the eight toasted halves and serve two halves per person.

m.note: Pressed sourdough with turkey, melting brie and cranberry sauce.
m.how: Spread 8 slices sourdough with 60g cranberry sauce. Divide 300g sliced cooked turkey and 160g brie among four slices and close the sandwiches. Butter the outsides using 30g softened butter. Press in a hot sandwich pan or frying pan weighted with a second pan for 3 to 4 minutes per side, until golden, the turkey is piping hot and the brie melts. Cut each sandwich in half.

w.note: Baked cheesecake with fresh strawberries macerated in a little sugar.
w.how: Use the remaining three quarters of the baked cheesecake slab prepared and chilled overnight for Cafe cheesecake bites. The shared slab uses 180g digestive biscuits, 75g butter, 600g cream cheese, 140g caster sugar, 150g sour cream, 3 eggs and 1 tsp vanilla extract; make it once only. Slice 250g fresh strawberries and toss with 15g caster sugar. Leave for 20 minutes to macerate. Cut the reserved cheesecake into four dessert slices and serve with the strawberries and their juices.
shop: shared cheesecake slab, ingredients listed with snack@Dairy

d.note: Double decaf espresso with steamed milk and a deep foam cap.
d.how: Use 72g decaf coffee beans to brew four double espressos, 60ml each, into warmed tall cups. Steam 600ml full cream milk in batches to 60°C, introducing enough air for a deep foam cap. Divide the steamed milk among the cups and spoon the foam on top. Serve immediately.
